entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1. The Court proceedings have been conducted through Video-Conferencing in view of the present scenario so as to maintain social distancing.

2. Mr. J. Singh, learned counsel has appeared for the petitioners and Mr. N. J. Dutta,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor has appeared for the respondents.

3. Sri Arun Kumar, Sri Nitin Dewan and Hotel Brahmaputra Ashok represented by its Managing Director have preferred this petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashing complaint dated 25.10.2013, CR Case No.3909 C/2013 pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kamrup (Metro) at Guwahati, under Sections 26(2)(i)/59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kamrup (Metro) at Guwahati
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. Having referred to the prayer clause, I find that only the proceedings initiated vide criminal complaint have been challenged.
Reference to para 4 of the petition indicates that the petitioners were summoned to stand trial vide order dated 25.11.2013.
5. In a case of this nature an accused would have cause of action to approach a court of law in challenge to proceedings only if the accused has been summoned to stand trial.

In this case, neither the order of summoning has been appended to the petition,
nor the same has been challenged 6.
In view of the above, I find no reason to interfere.

7. Dismissed.
8. Let a copy of the order be provided under the signatures of the Court Master.
CHIEF JUSTICE
